text:
deploy-bot: Tag created: v3.15.0-rc1 (commit a1b2c3d). Changelog summary: small payment API fix, improve batching in runtime, add telemetry for KV cache evictions. Environments: staging->canary->prod. Canary window: 60m, 10% traffic. Link: https://internal.redwood/release/v3.15.0-rc1 :shipit:

alice: Copying summary to release notes page, adding list of services to pin.

ben: Thanks. Can we pin payment-api to the RC in prod during canary? That service is sensitive.

carla: Recommend pin for payment-api only. We'll route 10% to canary hosts and monitor errors/latency. If errors spike >2x or 5xx rate >1% for 5m, rollback.

alice: Pin instructions (helm):
```
# pin payment-api to tag
helm upgrade payment-api ./charts/payment-api --set image.tag=v3.15.0-rc1 --namespace prod
```
Also pin list we plan: `payment-api`, `checkout-worker` (optional).

ben: I'll hold off on checkout-worker pin. Observability dashboards ready, tracing flags enabled.

carla: Oncall will watch logs and the rollout dashboard. If we need full rollback, use:
```
# quick rollback to previous stable
helm rollback payment-api 3 --namespace prod
```
I'll be online for the window.

alice: Noted. Can someone add runtime team as a reviewer in the canary thread? @ben please add.

ben: Added runtime-team to the canary thread and bumped the rollout to start in 10m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started for v3.15.0-rc1 (10% traffic) at 2094023490. Commit: a1b2c3d. Monitoring hooks live.

carla: Metrics look clean so far (5m). No obvious regressions.

alice: If all green at 60m we'll schedule the prod widen to 100%. Otherwise, follow rollback criteria above.

ben: Acknowledged. Will post final signoff or rollback call in this thread before 2094023520.

carla: Final: canary passed. Widening to 100% now. :tada:

deploy-bot: Canary finished. Widened to 100% at 2094023518. Release tag v3.15.0-rc1 is now serving prod traffic.
